syllabus_topics: Dynamic models – characteristics and methods of experimental characterization
Vibrations of discrete mechanical systems – beams and shafts
Dynamics of machine and structure state
Influence of vibrations on the human body
The basic problems of the Theory of elasticity: governing equations, plane problems, axisymmetric structures, plates, shells
FEM basis, types of finite elements, specifics in FEM solutions, preparation of problems, result analysis

assessment_methods.method: Written exam on theoretical questions and problems

assessment_rules: The grading system determines the minimum required for semester passing approval and the final grade after two written tests. If the final grade of the semester is high enough, the student can get this as a final grade of the course to get exempt from the exam. The exam is written and covers several theoretical questions and problems to be solved.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
